rule: Harmonize the 16 evidence-bound systems before binding more. Remaining 24 = controlled backlog.

demands.name: definition_alignment_pass
demands.question: Do all 16 bound systems cite the same panel/metric definitions for each shared domain?

demands.name: time_period_label_pass
demands.question: Are time periods explicit and non-blended on every critical number shown in bound compare layers?

demands.name: geography_label_pass
demands.question: Does every Arkansas relevance claim state US vs Arkansas vs county without national-to-local implication?

demands.name: evidence_status_language_pass
demands.question: Do supporting / contradicting / NEE buckets use the locked vocabulary and forbidden-claim list?

demands.name: controlled_backlog_gate
demands.question: Are the remaining 24 systems gated behind written-argument need rather than completeness optics?
